title: On the slow passage through a Hopf in a class of real-analytic systems: Exponential asymptotics and maximal delay
summary: In this paper, we consider the slow passage through a Hopf in $\mathbb R^3$ in a certain class of real-analytic systems. Classically, the (simplified) Shishkova problem: $ε\frac{dz}{dμ} = λ(μ) z+\mathcal O(ε)$, $λ(μ) = μ-ı$, has been used to illustrate the delay associated with slow passage through a Hopf at $μ=0$. In this paper, we consider a general $λ(μ)$ with $λ(0)\in i\mathbb R\setminus \{0\}$, $\real[λ'(0)]\ne 0$, and add an equation for the complex conjugate. It is a basic fact that these systems are local normal forms for any real-analytic $(1,2)$ slow-fast system in $\mathbb R^3$…
